source.description:
## PROBLEM
Final unitAI-o1fs4 security audit found residual mutable extension sources in operator-managed Specialists config (for example npm:pi-ast-grep, npm:pi-intercom, npm:@gotgenes/pi-subagents, and a git source) plus informational mixed-case legacy npm identity ambiguity. These are outside the canonical pi-service-knowledge pin but retain CWE-1104 exposure where enabled.

## SUCCESS
Inventory shipped and operator/bootstrap extension sources, classify ownership and mutability, define exact-pin or immutable-commit policy where appropriate, and add migration diagnostics without silently mutating user config. Decide with evidence whether legacy mixed-case npm names require normalized collision handling.

## SCOPE
Extension-source policy, config/bootstrap examples, migration warnings, focused tests, docs. Operator-managed current config is evidence only unless explicit approval authorizes mutation.

## NON_GOALS
No npm publication, no automatic global config rewrite, no weakening of unitAI-o1fs4 fail-closed behavior.

## VALIDATION
Source inventory, registry/git identity evidence, compatibility matrix, tests for any policy change, security/reviewer gates.

## OUTPUT
Risk-ranked inventory, chosen immutability rules, migration plan, and exact test evidence.
